name: Provincie Groningen Groene Initiatieven
summary: Province of Groningen subsidy for projects by residents' groups and non-profit foundations or associations that strengthen nature and landscape around their living environment, such as landscape structures linking village and countryside. 2026 budget EUR 80,000, first come first served.

eligibility.rule: Projects in a village or city must be connected to the landscape
Activities are lawful and compatible with the public interest, morals and public order
Activities are primarily directed at Groningen, benefit its residents, or otherwise serve the province
Activities have not started before the application is submitted
The same activities and eligible costs have not already received the maximum permitted subsidy
The applicant has no outstanding European Commission recovery order

documents: Completed project budget and financing plan
Chamber of Commerce extract, if applicable
Copies of commitments or applications from other financiers, if applicable
Copies of issued permits, if applicable
